verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS code-review product with a CLI, but nothing in the evidence describes disabling telemetry or usage tracking. The privacy docs cover only a related area: contractual no-training commitments from model providers and an option to block AI features for a workspace. Neither is a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out, so no credit is given.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
